fusions.name: Every Head Comes Up
fusions.desc: Stamps a warning in time with the herd that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stuns each for 1 second. Its damage rises 10% for each ally beside you (max 40%).

fusions.name: Chewed Cud
fusions.desc: Spits a wad of sour cud at the first enemy within 6 tiles that deals 4 damage, with a 30% chance to leave it [Damped] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Barn-Warm Fug
fusions.desc: Lets a warm fug settle where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 4 tiles. A grazen from the herd fights beside you for 6 seconds, striking for 3 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Warmth Kept In
fusions.desc: When you gain health, the healing you receive is 30% stronger for 8 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
